

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
ctd <- read_xlsx(here("files", "dean_2023.xlsx"), "Data")
```

```{r}
ctd <- ctd %>% 
  filter(`Cast Direction Flag` == "d") %>% 
  select(castpk = `Cast PK`,
         mt = `Measurement time`,
         pres = `Pressure (dbar)`,
         fl = `Fluorometry Chlorophyll (ug/L)`,
         tu = `Turbidity (FTU)`) %>% 
  mutate(date = date(mt))
```

```{r}
# Prepare data with month factor
ctd_plot <- ctd %>%
  filter(pres <= 50) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
         month2 = month(date)) %>% 
  filter(month2 >=5)

# Create fluorescence profile
p_fl <- ggplot(ctd_plot, aes(x = fl, y = pres, color = month, group = castpk)) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(50, 0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = "Chlorophyll (µg/L)", 
       y = "Pressure (dbar)",
       color = "Month") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2)
  )

# Create turbidity profile
p_tu <- ggplot(ctd_plot, aes(x = tu, y = pres, color = month, group = castpk)) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(50, 0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = "Turbidity (FTU)", 
       y = "Pressure (dbar)",
       color = "Month") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2)
  )

# Display
p_fl
p_tu

# Or combine with patchwork if you want them side-by-side
p_fl + p_tu + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

ggsave(here("figures", "dean_2023.png"),
       height = 12,
       width = 14)
```
